主要内容: On April 12, 2021, Gregory F. Covino resigned as Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer of Novavax, Inc. (the “Company”) effective April 12, 2021. Mr. Covino will remain an executive advisor to the Company under a new employment arrangement. In connection with Mr. Covino’s resignation, the Company appointed John J. Trizzino, Executive Vice President, Chief Commercial Officer, and Chief Business Officer of the Company, to serve as interim Chief Financial Officer. Mr. Covino’s employment as an executive advisor of the Company will be on an at-will basis pursuant to an employment agreement, pursuant to which Mr. Covino is entitled to an annual base salary of $262,500.
